notes: §1985:IX.4.6.2 prints REWRITE record-name-1 [ FROM identifier-1 ] [ INVALID KEY imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT INVALID KEY imperative-statement-2 ] [ END-REWRITE ], and §1985:IV.2.1 makes the printed sequence part of the format. The superset rule rewriteStatement parses it, SequentialIoBinder.BindRewrite routes an indexed file to KeyedIoBinder.BindRewrite, and at --std 85 VersionConformancePass refuses every later addition: the word RECORD (VisitRewriteStatement, COBOL0900, the landed fix of kb/Work PB5159), FROM a literal or figurative constant (VisitRecordFromPhrase, COBOL0871), RETRY and WITH LOCK (COBOL0900), FILE file-name (DeclinedFilePhrase, COBOL1706), and NOT INVALID KEY before INVALID KEY (VisitConditionalPhrases through ConditionalPhraseAssociation.OutOfPrintedOrder, COBOL0900, the landed fix of kb/Work PB5158). Both PARTIAL arms of the prior read are closed. Probed at --std 85: (a) an indexed record with OCCURS DEPENDING ON under RECORD VARYING rewritten from a group shorter than the maximum length read back 'K0014 4 DD'; FROM TE (N) and FROM TE (3) (1:10) at the item's bounds rewrote the right record. (b) the reversed phrase order is refused (the same program compiles and prints OK at 2002 and 2023), as are RECORD, INVALID KEY twice, END-REWRITE twice, a missing record-name, AT END and FROM after the phrases. (c) FROM literal, FROM SPACES, WITH LOCK, RETRY 3 TIMES and FILE IFILE are refused. (d) FROM a group, an elementary WKEY (invalid key 23) and a subscripted item. (e) RANDOM, DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access: a changed key in sequential access gives INV 21, a REWRITE after a READ at end gives status 43 with neither phrase run, a REWRITE after a failed READ gives INV 23, and NOT INVALID KEY alone with a USE procedure prints NOK then USE 23. The witness runs the printed format with a present key and an absent one. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5159 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-06.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-06-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "REWRITE record-name-1 [ FROM identifier-1 ] [ INVALID KEY imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT INVALID KEY ... ]"; 2023: "FILE file-name-1 ... FROM literal-1 ... [ retry-phrase ] WITH LOCK / WITH NO LOCK; INVALID KEY group in choice indicators". 2023 format adds FILE file-name-1, FROM literal-1, the RETRY and LOCK phrases, and allows INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY in either order, so it accepts programs 1985 refused.
